evidence.quote: To prevent leakage of future information, we do not allow even read access beyond the agent's workspace and accessible article folders up to the current simulation date

practical_problems.note: leakage-controlled chronological replay with a sandbox; the control is the benchmark design, not varied against a leaky setting calibration: chronological replay with sandbox used without a leaky contrast

evidence.quote: To measure the effect of these properties on FutureSim performance, we ablate full agentic

practical_problems.note: ablates daily arrival of news and agentic versus single-query search; also ablates memory write access

summary: FutureSim is a chronological replay benchmark for open-ended event forecasting by agents that measures frontier agents under leakage control, with ablations of news updates, search and memory; it is not a time series benchmark and changes no task.
